headline: Local AI Deployment Surges with WebAI Standard and Inference Chip Challenges
summary: The launch of Opera's WebAI standard and General Compute's $100 million funding for inference chips are driving local AI adoption. These developments are reshaping how AI models are deployed, reducing reliance on cloud services and proprietary hardware.
whyItMatters: This shift enhances data privacy, reduces latency, and democratizes access to advanced AI capabilities, fostering a more competitive and inclusive tech landscape.

primaryArticle.title: Opera Launches WebAI Standard for Local AI Deployment in Browsers

supportingStories.title: General Compute Secures $100 Million Series A, Challenges Nvidia Dominance in Inference Chips
